name: Samantha Harvey
bio: English novelist and essayist, winner of the 2024 Booker Prize for Orbital.

name: Paul Lynch
bio: Irish novelist known for poetic, atmospheric prose and the dystopian masterpiece Prophet Song.

name: Shehan Karunatilaka
bio: Sri Lankan writer and author of The Seven Moons of Maali Almeida, which won the 2022 Booker Prize.

name: Damon Galgut
bio: South African novelist and playwright, winner of the 2021 Booker Prize for The Promise.

name: Douglas Stuart
bio: Scottish-American fashion designer and writer whose debut novel Shuggie Bain won the 2020 Booker Prize.

name: Bernardine Evaristo
bio: British author and academic, first Black woman to win the Booker Prize (for Girl, Woman, Other in 2019).

name: Margaret Atwood
bio: Acclaimed Canadian author, two-time Booker Prize winner for The Blind Assassin (2000) and The Testaments (2019).

name: George Saunders
bio: American short story writer and novelist, winner of the 2017 Booker Prize for Lincoln in the Bardo.

name: Hilary Mantel
bio: Renowned British author who won the Booker Prize twice for Wolf Hall (2009) and Bring Up the Bodies (2012).

name: Colson Whitehead
bio: American novelist and two-time Pulitzer Prize winner for The Underground Railroad (2017) and The Nickel Boys (2020).

name: Barbara Kingsolver
bio: American novelist who won both the Pulitzer Prize for Fiction and the Women's Prize for Fiction for Demon Copperhead.

name: Hernan Diaz
bio: Argentine-American author whose novel Trust won the 2023 Pulitzer Prize for Fiction.

name: Jayne Anne Phillips
bio: American novelist and short story writer, winner of the 2024 Pulitzer Prize for Fiction for Night Watch.

name: Joshua Cohen
bio: American novelist and short story writer, winner of the 2022 Pulitzer Prize for The Netanyahus.

name: Louise Erdrich
bio: Acclaimed Indigenous American novelist, winner of the 2021 Pulitzer Prize for The Night Watchman and National Book Award.

name: Richard Powers
bio: American novelist whose works explore science, nature, and humanity; winner of the 2019 Pulitzer Prize for The Overstory.

name: Jesmyn Ward
bio: American author and academic, first woman to win two National Book Awards for Fiction (Salvage the Bones and Sing, Unburied, Sing).

name: Justin Torres
bio: American novelist, winner of the 2023 National Book Award for Fiction for Blackouts.

name: Tess Gunty
bio: American writer whose debut novel The Rabbit Hutch won the 2022 National Book Award for Fiction.

name: Jason Mott
bio: American author, poet, and winner of the 2021 National Book Award for Hell of a Book.

name: Charles Yu
bio: American author and television writer, winner of the 2020 National Book Award for Interior Chinatown.

name: V. V. Ganeshananthan
bio: Novelist, journalist, and essayist who won the 2024 Women's Prize for Fiction for Brotherless Night.

name: Ruth Ozeki
bio: Novelist, filmmaker, and Zen Buddhist priest; winner of the 2022 Women's Prize for Fiction.

name: Susanna Clarke
bio: British author of Jonathan Strange & Mr Norrell and the Women's Prize-winning novel Piranesi.

name: Maggie O'Farrell
bio: Award-winning author of Hamnet (2020 Women's Prize for Fiction) and The Marriage Portrait.

name: Jenny Erpenbeck
bio: Celebrated German author and playwright, winner of the 2024 International Booker Prize for Kairos.

name: Georgi Gospodinov
bio: Bulgarian writer, poet, and playwright, winner of the 2023 International Booker Prize for Time Shelter.

name: Geetanjali Shree
bio: Indian Hindi-language novelist and short-story writer; winner of the 2022 International Booker Prize for Tomb of Sand.

name: Han Kang
bio: South Korean writer, winner of the 2016 International Booker Prize for The Vegetarian and the 2024 Nobel Prize in Literature.

name: Arkady Martine
bio: American historian and speculative fiction writer, two-time Hugo Award winner for A Memory Called Empire and A Desolation Called Peace.

name: N. K. Jemisin
bio: Groundbreaking speculative fiction writer, the only author in history to win the Hugo Award for Best Novel in three consecutive years for the Broken Earth trilogy.

name: Lucy Ellmann
bio: Author of Ducks, Newburyport, winner of the 2019 Goldsmiths Prize and finalist for the Booker Prize.

name: Mircea Cărtărescu
bio: Romanian writer and poet, author of the monumental Solenoid, winner of the 2024 International Dublin Literary Award.
